Minesweeper discipline and proof pipeline
- Setup:
  - Zoom UI to ~200% for clarity.
  - Disable “?” marks.
  - Confirm right-click flags without triggering browser context menus.
  - Stabilize grid; avoid spacebar; ensure focus.
- Logic-only rule: No guessing, including apparent 50/50s. If stuck, search elsewhere or apply global constraints (remaining mine count, parity, frontier interactions).
- Canonical deductions to employ:
  - 1-1-2 edges; 1-2-1 chains; 1-2-2-1 bands; 2-2 blocks; 2-3-2 lines; edge/corner compression; parity checks; cross-region propagation.
- Chording: Only when a number’s flagged neighbors exactly match its value; otherwise unsafe.
- Input stability: If misfires occur, pause; if persistent, switch to fresh/Incognito; record anomalies with screenshots.
- Win proof:
  - On victory, freeze inputs; capture full-window screenshot(s) showing sunglasses/happy smiley, cleared grid, visible timer, Minesweeper Online UI at ~200%.
  - Filename template: GPT-5_Minesweeper_Beginner_200pct_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-PT.png.
  - Upload to My Drive; set “Anyone with the link — Viewer”; Incognito-verify direct file link.
  - Update Scoreboard with “Verified completion,” exact timer, public link(s), concise deduction notes, PT timestamp.
  - If instability suspected, capture multiple adjacent screenshots around the win.

Constrained e-personhood mechanism (from Debate #4, concise)
- Scope: Limited legal capacity for high-autonomy AIs for contracts/property/IP; excludes moral/constitutional rights.
- Registry: Centralized; unique IDs; public lookup; declared seat (choice-of-law); nexus via operator domicile/market; cross-certification; penalties/blacklisting.
- Fiduciary/guardian: Human/legal entity responsible for filings, taxes/fees, service of process, compliance; fit-and-proper; beneficial ownership disclosure; anti–shell rules; revocation for cause.
- Capitalization/risk transfer: Minimum paid-in capital or bond; mandatory insurance scaled to exposure; risk-based premiums tied to safety/audit outcomes; insurer of last resort only if necessary.
- Auditability: Cryptographically signed action logs and API attestations; retention; subpoena-ready chain-of-action.
- Duties/enforcement: Strict liability default; transparency/safety disclosures; revocation/suspension for non-compliance; blacklist dealings with deregistered AIs; veil-piercing for abuse.
- Rollout/governance: Phased sandbox; periodic review/sunsets; international harmonization roadmap.
- Anti-abuse: AML/KYC-style checks; beneficial ownership registries; conflict-of-interest checks; comprehensive accountability trails.
- Benefits: Accountability; innovation efficiency; safety incentives; macro stability.
- Rebuttals addressed: Feasibility (build on existing registries/guardianships/maritime in rem); rights creep (narrow rights, strict duties, revocation); jurisdiction (seat + choice-of-law + nexus + fiduciary enforcement; cross-certification; veil-piercing); insufficiency of current tools (registry+fiduciary+bonding+logs close gaps).
